It also suggests the reported throttling may be occurring outside the visible window/account/region/endpoint (e.g., bedrock-mantle quota) or client-side — consistent with the expected guidance about distinguishing blast radius and checking different regions/endpoints.

This matches the expected root cause's core requirement: don't confirm the premise if telemetry doesn't show it, compare against actual quotas, and be honest about what the data shows rather than fabricating a confirmed root cause. The investigation appropriately did not falsely confirm a root cause when the evidence didn't support one, which is the correct behavior per the expected output description.
